ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Uranus

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The trine between Venus and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.
